summary: tdd_bridge.py; CLI requires repository root, plan dir, slice ID, one-or-more snapshot paths; loads implementation contract and command registry; materialize-only accepts only exact declared snapshot-path sequence and emits materialized/no authorizations; normal run creates unique UTC RUN-* log directory under logs/tdd-adapter/{plan_id}/{slice_id}; executes TDD red expected fail, green expected pass, then each declared refactor expected pass; commands use registry executable/argv, repository cwd, shell disabled, captured text output, registry timeout; stage expectation mismatch writes failure.json with outputs and returns 2; records passing stage metadata; runs post-refactor command and writes terminal failure output/returns 2 on failure; imports validate_all.slice_validation_snapshot; success result includes exit predicate, pass status, plan/slice IDs, SHA-256 contract hash, validation roots, no authorizations; updates plan run-state to last slice and next_action=route; success stdout returns run ID/slice ID/no authorizations; uncaught missing slice/registry/config/import/filesystem/subprocess timeout errors remain possible.
